name: BACH_0283
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Conformal set holds Invasive only; second model and all 5 neighbors agree [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu <1% | Near-certain |
| Conformal set | {Invasive}, α=0.1 | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 1.00 / 68th percentile | Typical, input sound |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Independent model concurs |
| Similar cases | 5/5 Invasive | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 1, 3, 8) · ↑ invasive · Scored above typical; strongest concept-model association with invasive carcinoma · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 1, 7, 9) · ↑ invasive · Scored well above typical across all regions · Validated
- **Scarce gland/tubule formation** (region 10) · ↑ invasive · Low tubule score adds toward invasive in concept model · Validated
- **Larger, more variable nuclei** (regions 1, 4, 5) · context · Size and variation both at 93rd percentile of reference · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0: not shown to reflect the classifier. Mitoses (0/20) and necrosis (3/20) are Unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- Concept associations are unvalidated against the classifier; spot checks came from an AI reviewer, not a pathologist.
- Dataset checks used 132 test cases; ECE upper bound 0.18 leaves room for miscalibration.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 1, 3, 8:** Confirm tumor cells infiltrate stroma, not reactive or benign stroma.
2. **Regions 1, 4, 5:** Verify enlarged, variable nuclei; HoVer-Net measured only these regions.
3. **Region 10:** Confirm gland formation is sparse; nearest InSitu case differs most on tubules.
